preamble: Clues are normal but a single letter must be added to each solution, making another word or phrase (as enumerated). These should be fitted into the grid, jigsaw-wise. The inserted letters include the whole alphabet at least once, but with three A’s and two E’s, F’s, N’s and T’s. The clues are listed in alphabetical order of the inserted letters.
